correctness.rationale: The m-by-m Hankel matrix reduces exactly to one 2-by-2 shear block. Poisson variance gives the angular/radial profile; the comparison against r=0 factors through two exact roots. The derivative of log c_+(t) has one interior zero for all m>=4 and only an endpoint maximum for m=3, proving the complete stated phase criterion and equality sets. Cubic optimization and uniform small-radius exclusion prove the limiting optimizer transition. The included 454 standard-library diagnostics verify finite sample computations without being used for the infinite-degree claim.

value.rationale: In the natural family of the two lowest-complexity nonmonomial Hardy Hankel symbols with unbounded degree, the exact optimizer of the canonical reproducing-kernel lower bound undergoes a sharp, globally classified origin/nonorigin transition. The coexistence of m-1 off-center witnesses and local-versus-global metastability above cubic degree are not implied by mere failure of the strong reproducing kernel thesis, and give substantive parameter and equality geometry rather than an isolated recomputation.
